sentences.en: You have a responsibility to explain that behavior to me.
sentences.zh: 你有责任向我解释那种行为。

sentences.en: His bad behavior is a reflection on his common sense.
sentences.zh: 他的不良行为反映了他缺乏常识。

sentences.en: I was bewildered at the sight of his strange behavior.
sentences.zh: 看到他那奇怪的行为，我感到困惑。

senses.zh: 行为，举止；表现，举止；(动物的)习性；(事物的)特性，性能；(群体的)行为方式
